content.comment_body: Hello everyone, If I have a network project open in [product_name] with several controllers, is it possible to upload the programs to all connected devices at once, or must each one be uploaded separately?
You can only upload to a single [product_name] device at a time.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether it's possible to upload programs to multiple networked controllers simultaneously using [product_name]. The answer clarified that programs can only be uploaded to one device at a time, highlighting that batch uploading is not supported. This limitation affects efficiency for users handling multiple controllers in a network project.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected [product_name] to offer the ability to upload programs to multiple controllers concurrently within a network project.
